summary.text: Jim Thomas is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 49 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. An attorney and former professional tennis player, he chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Thomas was born in Canton, Ohio, and earned a bachelor’s degree from Stanford University in 1996 and a law degree from Case Western Reserve University in 2013.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and as a professional tennis player.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Plain Township, had a twelve-year professional tennis career competing in 50 countries, and was a small business owner specializing in residential real estate, an attorney and a trustee in Jackson Township.
Thomas won the District 49 seat in 2022 by defeating incumbent Thomas West, and he was re-elected in 2024 over Krista Allison.
In the 2025–2026 session he serves on the House Finance, Education, Ways and Means and Judiciary committees, and chairs Judiciary.

In the 2022 survey, Thomas listed tax cuts for families and businesses, support for the Pro Football Hall of Fame and Hall of Fame Village as drivers of Stark County tourism, and backing for direct funding of vouchers and charter schools as his key campaign messages.
